title: Finite torsion point sections have finite cohomology
statement: For the finite-field datum D, prime l different from D.p, finite extension E of Q_l, and n >= 1, termwise canonical point sections of any complex with intrinsic finite-torsion constructible derived object have bounded finite cohomology over ULift A_(E,n).

source.place: the assertion that evaluation at the geometric point lands in $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}$

proof.text: Use finite-ring etale origin. For its etale antecedent, constructibility gives finite generation of global sections at the algebraically closed point by Etale.finite_Γ_of_isConstructibleSheaf. The coefficient ring is finite, so the section module is a finite set. The finite-level comparison unit and the origin equivalence counit transport finiteness to pro-etale final-object sections. Exact evaluation and scalar restriction commute with complex homology, hence with derived homology through homologyFunctorFactors. Preserve the original finite support and transport finiteness along these homology isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Point evaluation, finite/integral/rational landing assertions; original six-step proof, specialized as recorded

theorem point_sections_finiteness_finiteTorsion (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∀ C : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
          ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology (Spec (.of D.k)))
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
              ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (Spec (.of D.k))) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
                (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n)))))) ℤ,
      intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E n hn (Spec (.of D.k)) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) →
        DerivedCategory.pointFiniteCohomology
          (ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n))
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((pointFiniteSections D.k (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj C)))
